installation.script:
set -e
cd /mnt/server

if ! command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        apt-get update && apt-get install -y git
    elif command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        apk add --no-cache git
    else
        echo "No supported package manager found to install git" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
fi

if [ ! -d .git ]; then
    echo "Cloning ${GITHUB_REPO}"
    git clone "${GITHUB_REPO}" .
else
    echo "Repo already present, pulling latest"
    git pull
fi

mkdir -p /mnt/server/logs

if [ ! -f package.json ]; then
    echo "package.json still missing after clone, aborting" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
    npm ci --include=dev
else
    npm install --include=dev
fi

npm run build

variables.name: DISCORD_TOKEN
variables.description: Discord Bot Token from Discord Developer Portal

variables.name: DISCORD_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: Discord User ID of the Discord Bot (Right Click Bot Profile -> Copy User ID)

variables.name: DATABASE_URL
variables.description: Postgres Database URL (must start with postgresql://)

variables.name: DEVELOPER_IDS
variables.description:
An array of the IDs for users with developer access
Format: ["0123456789", "9876543210"]

variables.name: ENABLE_API
variables.description: Enable this to let the pegasus dashboard communicate directly with the bots codebase. Set to FALSE when you havent deployed a dashboard to add a layer of security.

variables.name: API_PORT
variables.description: The port the API will run on. Automatically filled from the server's primary allocation.

variables.name: BOT_API_TOKEN
variables.description: Authorization Token for the Bots internal API which primary purpose serves for the pegasus-dashboard

variables.name: API_TOKEN (legacy)
variables.description: Legacy support for API_TOKEN, we recommend to use BOT_API_TOKEN. Tho both should have the same value.

variables.name: STEAM_API_KEY
variables.description: Steam API Key if you need steam features

variables.name: RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW
variables.description: Rate Limit Window (For hosting providers, we recommend to set this variable manually to prohibit possible attacks and locking it to 'Users Can View' only)

variables.name: RATE_LIMIT_MAX_REQUESTS
variables.description: Max requests within the time window. (For hosting providers, we recommend to set this variable manually to prohibit possible attacks and locking it to 'Users Can View' only)

variables.name: SUPPORT_SERVER_INVITE
variables.description: Discord invite link to the support server of the person hosting this bot
